views.title: O:I shell · area × native product
views.semantics: Each intersection asks: which shell devices and instrument targets in this area draw on this native product, and as what? A placement exists only where a manual entry's Product line names the product (coverage 'product' when it is the entry's product, 'with' when named after 'with'), or where a target's native_owners name it (coverage 'native-owner'). The houses row places the devices §16.1 names in each house a second time. The direction is always shell → product: the shell presents, the product owns the operation and its state. Empty means unassessed, never absent or impossible.

row_axis.label: Shell areas
row_axis.ordering: Part Three's families in order (§17 Technē and the instruments that open in any mode, §18 Central, §19 Factory, §20 Expressions, §21 Live; §22 → Any mode; §23 → the window's rail), then Part One's Settings (§10.10–§10.11) and the houses (§10.4, §16.1)

views.title: Instrument lanes · lane × native product
views.semantics: Each intersection asks: which of this lane's acceptance targets name this native product among their owners (targets.json native_owners or contract_owner)? Every target names 'O:I Expression kernel' (O:I's own, no column) and 'Central / AIKit declared source owners'. Empty means unassessed.

provenance.account: docs/dlw/DLW.md, the Digital Logos Workstation manual, is the governing account: the owner calls it the vision and the main spec.
provenance.policy: One matrix for the S whole. The desktop's feature claims are capability rows that relate to the native products they read; native capabilities stay in their own products' matrices and are not copied here (CAPABILITY-MATRIX-PROTOCOL.md, Native product view). Rows: the devices the manual embeds, the 126 targets of the instrument-lane register (statuses carried as recorded), and the 38 S-position rows of the 2026-09-06 recovery matrix (ids preserved). Evidence is never generated to fill a column; empty means unassessed.
provenance.generator: python3 -I gen.py --root <o-i tree>; kept outside the repository, in the generating session's scratchpad (matrix/gen.py)

device_gaps.note: joins recovery-matrix rows to admitted family faces; params were empty for every family, so no per-device owner-served key count exists

native_refs.method: exact string match of a target's owner_op backticked operation names, or a device's declared write path after '<product>-cli:', against the native matrices' cli_commands

registers_carried.suite/capability-matrix.json: its 38 S-position rows are carried here with ids, evidence and per-source verdicts; its S0–S5 rows stay with the native matrices; the file stays as the recovery's historical extraction
its 126 targets are rows here with statuses as recorded; the register keeps the full definitions and evidence until the owner retires it
registers_carried.not_reconciled_here: suite/product-capabilities.json (the native S0–S5 catalogue, left alone), packages/live-shell/ui/src/inhabitants/capabilityHomes.ts and T-COVERAGE
